text: Welcome.
These few minutes are for the part of you that makes things.
Along the way, I'll give you a few words to say to yourself.
Feel the weight of your body.
Feel whatever is holding you up.
Now bring to mind the work you make.
The things only you can create.
It takes courage to make something.
And you do it anyway.
That courage lives in your body.
Feel it as warmth, low and steady.
Your creative work comes from a deep well.
It's yours, and it's always full.
Now say these to yourself, silently.
I trust my ideas.
I trust my hands.
Now picture the next thing you're going to make.
See yourself beginning it.
Let your breath come back to its own pace.
Open your eyes when you're ready.
Allow yourself to go create something.
The world is waiting for it.
